_note: Full 60-card Ashborn set (matches the tracker's 60-card target and cost curve exactly). ASH001-045 built across prior sessions; ASH046-060 (cost 5-10) added 2026-08-14 to fill out the top of the curve, following user-specified guidance: total stats ~2-2.5x cost split attack-heavy on Attack-row units / health-heavy on Defense-row units, stronger effects trimming stats down, rarity jumps bumping stats back up. Rarity across the new 15: 8 Common, 3 Rare, 2 Epic, 2 Legendary (user-specified exact counts). ASH043 Bloodforged Golem's plain-text "whenever a friendly unit is destroyed" ability was retrofitted to use the new Echo keyword (added to keywords.json same session) instead of unique unkeyworded text. Effect text condensed from the docx's original wording where possible, meaning preserved (see chat for the specific before/after on each). || 100-card expansion (2026-08-17): ASH061-100 added to bring Ashborn from 60 to 100 cards, per user directive targeting Attack28/Defense28/Support-unit14/Spells20/Support-duration10. 40-card expansion for Ashborn (ASH061-100), bringing the faction from 60 to 100 cards. Built to fill gaps identified by comparing the original 60 against the new 100-card target (Attack28/Defense28/Support-unit14/Spells20/Support-duration10 per faction): Ashborn was Attack-heavy and Defense/Support-light (21/14/7), and its cost curve was nearly empty at 6-10 with literally zero Defense or Support-row units above cost 5. This batch adds +7 Attack/+14 Defense/+7 Support-unit/+8 Spells/+4 Support-duration, concentrated to fill the top-end row gap and round out every cost bracket 0-10 (final curve 5/12/13/13/12/11/9/8/7/5/5). Rarity additions (+25/+9/+4/+2) keep the exact same 62/23/10/5 proportion as the original 37/14/6/3. UnitType additions (+7 Human/+8 Animal/+7 Elemental/+4 Construct/+2 Dragon) lean into Animal/Elemental/Construct specifically since those were thinnest relative to Human's 40% share in the original 60.
